headline: No votes taken; members discussed cluster subdivision rules, rural zoning density, and a possible November meeting date.
summary: No votes were taken. Members discussed the cluster ordinance, rural lot sizes, and a progress report due to the mayor on November 20th.
discussion: Cluster ordinance: Members discussed whether cluster subdivisions in the rural farm zone are mandatory or optional, and whether the ordinance should be repaired.
Rural density: Members said one-acre and half-acre lot sizes allow sprawl. They noted Bitterford's rural zoning may be the most permissive in York County.
Frontage and setbacks: Members said reducing street frontage in areas without sewer and water could lead to problems and big expense for the city.
Meeting schedule: Members discussed holding the November and December meetings on a Thursday, and whether staff must attend meetings held in City Hall's room.
Live broadcast and archived videos: Members said meetings held outside the council chambers often have no video posted, and the public archive appears empty.
